This role is for someone who can identify the right prospects, get in front of decision-makers, start meaningful conversations, and build a qualified pipeline that ultimately leads to closed business through outbound efforts. This is not a sit-back-and-wait sales role, and it is not a position for someone who needs a completely built sales system handed to them. We want someone who can take ownership of prospecting, contribute ideas, test different approaches, and work directly with our Founder to develop LaunchTec's outbound sales strategy. You would be the first dedicated person in our sales division , meaning there is significant opportunity—but also significant responsibility. We need someone comfortable operating without a perfect blueprint, bringing deals to the table, identifying what works, and helping us build that blueprint together. For the right person, this position has the potential to grow into a full-time role and eventually a leadership position overseeing and building LaunchTec's sales division. Qualified Meeting Bonus $175 for every qualified meeting you generate that: Takes place as scheduled Completes a discovery call with LaunchTec Results in LaunchTec providing the prospect with a proposal There is no set cap on qualified meeting bonuses. Uncapped Commission You will also earn: 15% commission on LaunchTec's profit from deals closed as a direct result of your outbound efforts. For recurring/retainer clients, you will continue earning 15% of LaunchTec's profit from that client for the first three months of the retainer , assuming the client remains active. Example: If your outreach generates a client producing $2,000/month in profit for LaunchTec, you would earn: $300 for Month 1 $300 for Month 2 $300 for Month 3 That's $900 in commission from one recurring client , in addition to your hourly pay and applicable qualified meeting bonus. There is no commission cap. The goal is to create a compensation structure where someone who consistently generates real business can earn substantially more than their hourly rate. Who We're Looking For We are looking for someone who: Has previous experience in business development, outbound sales, lead generation, appointment setting, or a similar role Has a proven ability to generate qualified opportunities through outbound prospecting Understands how to research companies and identify the correct decision-makers Is comfortable communicating directly with business owners, executives, and marketing decision-makers Can write personalized, human outreach instead of relying entirely on generic automated sequences Is comfortable with cold outreach and persistent follow-up Understands that outbound sales requires testing, iteration, volume, and consistency Is organized and capable of managing multiple conversations and follow-ups simultaneously Can work independently without needing to be micromanaged Brings ideas to the table instead of simply waiting for instructions Is motivated by performance-based compensation and uncapped earning potential Wants to help build something rather than simply step into an already established sales machine Experience selling digital marketing, advertising, websites, SEO, SaaS, professional services, or other B2B services is strongly preferred. You Probably Aren't a Fit If Your experience is primarily handling inbound leads that were already interested You rely entirely on scripts or automated tools to generate conversations You need a complete list of leads and exact instructions provided every day You are uncomfortable cold calling, cold emailing, or reaching out directly to decision-makers You measure success based on outreach volume rather than qualified opportunities and revenue You are looking for a traditional corporate sales environment with an established SDR playbook Why Join LaunchTec? This isn't a role where you'll be salesperson #47 following a process someone else created. You'll work directly with the Founder and have the opportunity to help build LaunchTec's sales operation from the ground up. As the company grows, we want the person who proves they can generate business to grow with it. That could mean increased hours, increased earning potential, additional sales resources underneath you, and eventually the opportunity to lead the sales division you helped create. If you're entrepreneurial, competitive, comfortable creating your own opportunities, and want your compensation to directly reflect the revenue you help generate, we'd like to hear from you. The department is known for its collaborative approach, deep sector expertise and genuine curiosity about our clients' businesses. The Innovation department has a dedicated Business Development and Growth function that works in close partnership with lawyers and specialists across the practice groups, helping to support the continued growth and success of one of the firm's most dynamic and strategically important areas. The Role The Growth Executive is a central member of the Innovation Department's Business Development function, responsible for project managing the delivery of events, sponsorships, and other key client acquisition activities, whilst supporting other key growth efforts in digital campaigns and sales as required. You will provide vital support to the Senior Business Development & Growth Executive and Strategy & Growth Manager to achieve new client acquisition objectives across the varied Innovation Department disciplines. The role holder will operate effectively as part of a team, working closely with practice groups and a wide range of internal and external stakeholders to deliver successful activations (events, sponsorships and other client acquisition activities) that support targeted client acquisition and measurable sales pipelines, as well as supporting efforts to retain and grow existing relationships. You will be required to be resilient, confident, and comfortable in your dealings with multiple priorities, with a focus on building successful and productive working relationships and flexing your style as required. Effective communication and team-working, energy, with great visibility and a can-do attitude will be the key to success in this role. You will report regularly to and support the Senior Business Development & Growth Executive, who has responsibility for the successful delivery of growth orientated activities, and your line manager will be the Strategy & Growth Manager overseeing the Department's new client acquisition efforts. Manage all logistical aspects of events from initial concept through to post-event follow-up, establishing processes to ensure all aspects are flawlessly delivered and bring creative thinking to how acquisition outcomes can be achieved. Being physically present across key hosted and sponsored events, handling issues and smooth delivery, supporting our central Events team. Collaborate with the BD content team to ensure events are supported by relevant thought leadership materials and post-event content. Support the tracking of event ROI and client engagement metrics, feeding insight back into campaigns and strategy planning of the Senior Business Development & Growth Executive and Strategy & Growth Manager. Sponsorship Management Drive outcomes from sponsorships with key industry partners such as startup/scaleup incubators, industry bodies, sector influencers and government agencies, coordinating the Departments' approach to enabling these parties to generate new prospect leads. Develop initiatives and tactics that facilitate better collaboration with sponsors, maintaining department awareness of ways to engage and realize potential acquisition opportunities. Launch systematic approaches to ensure sponsorship engagement, delivery and tracking of outcomes can be done at scale with limited support required. Take initial ownership of these activities to deeply understand how value can be created, and client acquisition and retention opportunities can be realized. Work with internal support stakeholders to embed processes and measure success, ensuring future delivery and tracking of outcomes can be done on a scale with limited support required. Aid in the production of regular pipeline and sales reporting for BD leadership and the wider partnership. What You'll Do After completing our Certification Program, you'll be on the phones, driving outbound activity, and contributing to generating deal opportunities. CRM Management: Maintain meticulous records of all interactions, ensuring the data accurate, up to date and follow-ups are never missed. Brand Ambassadorship: Represent Run for Charity with professional energy, clearly articulating how our membership helps charities raise more while reducing risk. Market Insights: Identify and share insights from charity conversations to help improve internal processes and product development. Charity Fluency: You understand (or are eager to learn) the unique landscape of the charity sector and the challenges they face.
